physDesc.additional: Script: dpe tshugs. Orthography: - Abundant use of abbreviations (e.g., ye shes, phyag ’tshal lo, gzugs, final –gs, etc.) - Bindu for m - Numerals used for numbers and for phonetic value (e.g., 4+n for bzhin) Interlinear insertions in smaller script on f. 1b6, f. 2a2 and f. 2a3 (titles for groups of verses) and a few corrections.

body.ab: || dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lU i pa'i bstod pa yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs s+ho ||

lg.l: gang gis 'khor ba'i nyaMs thag ni ||
dran pa bal gyis 'joMs mdzad cing ||
bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa ||
bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo ||
skye med ngang mas thugs rje chen po yis ||

keng rus
'jigs su rung pa'i gdan stengs su ||
bdud 'dul hUM las khro bo'i sku sprul ba ||
bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo ||
chos dbyings rnaM dag 'gyur med nam mkha' la ||
mtshon pa'i skur bstan dpa' bo'i rgyan gyis spras ||
thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rol ba mdzad ||
bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo ||
dpa' bo'i stang stabs khro bo 'jigs su rung ||
sgeg pa'i nyaMs can snogs rgyan gyis spras ||
rgod dang mi sdug snying rjes zhi ba mdzad ||
'gal ba'i chos 'chang bde mchog phyag 'tshal lo ||
gang la chags dang sdang ba mi mnga' yang ||
gang gis 'dul ba de dang‹de dang› de'i sras ||
chags sogs nyon mongs kun tu zhi mdzad pa'i ||
bcom ldan bde ba'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo ||

sgrib gnyis
nyes pa'i rgyu tshogs rnaM par spang‹s› ||
sdug bsngal 'bras bu'i tshogs dang bral ba nyid ||
'khor dang mya ngan 'da' la mi gnas pa'i ||
gnyis med ye shes bde mchog la phyag 'tshal ||
dag pa chos sku'i sprul pa ni ||

dmigs pa med pa'i
thugs rje yis ||
gzugs sku sgyu ma ltar ston pa ||
rdo rje phag mo phyag 'tshal lo ||
ye shes bzhi'i ngo bo yi ||
mkha' 'gro la ma dum skyes ma ||
gzugs can ma dang thod pa bzhi ||
bde chen 'khor lo phyag 'tshal lo ||

ab.note: 'khor lo gsum gyi *** rnaMs la bstod pa ni ||

lg.l:
rab tu gtum mo gtuM mig
ma ||
'od ldan sna tshogs brtan pa'i blo ||
mi thung lang ka'i dbang phyug ma ||
shing grib ma la phyag 'tshal lo ||
sa bsrungs ma dang 'jigs byed che ||
rlung shugs chang 'thung ljang lha mo ||
shin tu bzang mo rta sna mo ||
bya gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo ||
'khor shug kha NDa ro ha dang ||
chang 'thung go cha rab dpa' mo ||
stobs chen 'khor lo bsgyur ma dang ||
brtson chen ma la phyag 'tshal lo ||

ab.note: dpa' ba rnaMs la bstod pa ni ||

lg.l:
thod pa'i
dum bu keng rus che ||
keng rus mche rtsigs lha'i sgra ||
'od dpag med dang rdo rje'i 'od ||
rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod ||
myu gu can dang ral pa can ||
dpa' chen hUM mdzad rab tu bzang ||

rdo rje bzang dang
'jigs byed che ||
mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo ||
stobs chen rin chen rdo rje dang ||
rta mgrin mkha' snying he ru ka ||
padma gar dbang rnaM snang dang ||
rdo rje seMs la phyag 'tshal lo ||

ab.note: sgo 'tshams ma brgyad la bstod pa ni ||

lg.l:
phyogs bzhi'i sgo rnaMs skyong mdzad
pa ||
khwa gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma ||
de bzhin khyi'i gdong ma dang ||
phag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo ||
gzugs gnyis kyis ni yid 'phrog ma ||
brtan pa mo dang pho nya mo ||
mche brtsigs ma dang 'joMs ma dang ||

gshin rje
bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo ||

body.ab: lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bstod pa rdzogs s+ho || || dge'o ||
